# Sephora

> Sephora is a global beauty retailer offering makeup, skincare, fragrance, and hair products with an integrated loyalty program.

Sephora serves as a comprehensive beauty destination featuring curated product collections, brand partnerships, and the Beauty Insider loyalty program. The platform includes both direct Sephora stores and partnerships like Sephora at Kohl's.

## Key Topics

- Beauty Insider
- Makeup
- Skincare
- Fragrance
- Hair Products
- Loyalty Program
- Brand Launches
- KAYALI
- Seasonal Promotions
- Sephora at Kohl's
- Beauty Insider Challenge
- Product Collections
- Sweet Peach
- Plush Pear
